purpose: Golden semantic fixtures for text normalization, understanding, classification, ambiguity, duplicate handling and review safety. These are not verified bank/provider templates and must not be used as proof of actual provider SMS formats.
safety_invariants: No fixture may authorize a financial write directly.
Every proposed financial event remains subject to user review and confirmation.
pending is not a final posted transaction.
amount alone is never sufficient evidence to match an existing transaction.
balance-only, OTP, promotion, reminder, payment request, failed transaction and future intent do not create a posted financial transaction.
credit-card payment may be understood as a draft but must remain blocked from confirmed SMS execution until the operation is explicitly supported and approved.
refund and reversal are not new purchases; reversal must not silently delete the original event.

schema.amount: Decimal string or null; no binary floating point.
schema.unresolved_fields: Semantic fields that must be clarified before command mapping.
schema.financial_write_allowed_from_fixture: Always false; this corpus is for understanding/review tests only.
schema.provider_format_verified: Always false for this corpus; provider IDs are test grouping only.
